body:
I am a nuclear Engineer.  I had mild narcolepsy and fell asleep at work and sometimes experienced micro-naps while driving.  At work, I'm constantly reviewing technical reports and studying new information.  I frequently take examinations and have descended into barely being able to compete with my younger counterparts.  However, with Provigil, taking it at 4:30 am when I wake up, I am alert all day and have risen as the master of my area of expertice.  The young pups are amazed at my stamina and sharpness of mind.  Provigil has revived my intellect, retention and ability to function on a high-tech level 100% of the time.
I now sleep better at night because I have burned more energy during the day.  My career is fun again.
